displayName: Indy TIdSMTP wrapper (Java 17 + Spring Boot + JUnit 5)
description: Reference Delphi→Java-17 scaffold for the Indy TIdSMTP family. Delphi's TComponent + ARC interfaces + property accessors + events translate to a plain Java class implementing AutoCloseable, with explicit getter/setter pairs and a Listener-interface for status events. Spring's @Component decorator is wired so the connection class can be auto-injected. Produces a buildable mvn-test-runnable package with the connection class, the host-interface contract, the auxiliary value types, and a JUnit 5 fixture set tied to the signed spec.

matches.fallback: Used whenever the routine's enclosing_class matches a TIdSMTP* family member.
